title: BDD Scenario Development with Reqnroll + NUnit
prerequisites: Understanding of Gherkin and Reqnroll bindings
Basic knowledge of Minimal API endpoint behavior
Ability to read feature docs under docs/features and specs

inputs.description: Information required before authoring BDD scenarios
items: API contract details (route, method, headers, payload)
Matching step definition class with [Binding] methods
Passing BDD test scenarios aligned to docs and specs

successCriteria: Scenarios map directly to acceptance criteria from specs
Step phrases in .feature and [Binding] attributes match exactly
Assertions are contract-first and validate status code, response structure, and key data fields
BDD tests pass via dotnet test without external services
nonGoals: Implementing new domain entities or appservices logic
Replacing integration/unit tests outside BDD scope
